hints.title: Tracking Smallest Two Predecessor Costs
hints.text: Rather than checking all k prior colors for each house, only the absolute smallest and second smallest costs from the previous house are needed.

hints.title: Color Collision Prevention with Second Minimum
hints.text: If a house chooses the color that achieved the minimum in the prior house, it takes the second minimum instead to prevent adjacent color conflicts.

hints.title: Single Pass per House Updating Extremes
hints.text: Maintain prev_min1, prev_min2, and prev_idx from the preceding house. For each color c in the current house, cost is color cost plus prev_min2 if c == prev_idx else prev_min1. Track the new two minimums.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N * K) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating all other K - 1 colors for each color decision requires quadratic O(N * K^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching only the best two costs from the previous row reduces time from O(N * K^2) to O(N * K).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should achieve O(N * K) time without allocating extra DP matrices.
